title: Changes in the company name
text: Our Company was originally incorporated as "Jibansatya Printing House Private Limited", a private limited company under the Companies Act, 1956 on August 17, 1989 at Kolkata, West Bengal. The name of our Company was subsequently changed to "GPT Healthcare Private Limited" on March 31, 2005. Thereafter, our Company was converted to a public limited company and our name was changed to "GPT Healthcare Limited on September 15, 2021.
